name: 14623 · Rochester, NY
findings: ZIP 14623 (Rochester) has 180 nonprofit organizations. 101 of them (56%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 87 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 14623 (Rochester) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 14623 (Rochester) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.7 times the typical level).
